style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.ct_failed_rite: The master suite by candle stubs: a runic circle cut into the floor, charred bones in the middle
pictures.ct_failed_rite_2: A tear-stained parchment: a crude crooked tree over a mound, scratched words beneath
pictures.ct_between_the_trees: A ruby eye between blue-black pine trunks
pictures.ct_between_the_trees_2: A grey horn and a shaggy black flank sliding out of sight between the trees
pictures.ct_live_deliciously: Clouds swallowing the moon over a dark wood
pictures.ct_live_deliciously_2: A huge black goat stepping from the thicket, its third eye opening
pictures.ct_six_horns_his_crown: A moonlit clearing, an impossibly tall crooked tree on its mound, a goat skull with a wooden moon between its horns
pictures.ct_six_horns_his_crown_2: The Crooked Moon above the tree, enormous and grinning
pictures.ct_druskenvald_kneels: Roots crawling over a kneeling man in a pinstriped suit
pictures.ct_druskenvald_kneels_2: His body torn upward through a barrow roof
pictures.ct_druskenvald_kneels_3: Outside, the tree bulging as a winged goat shape unfolds from it
pictures.ct_born_king: The beast made flesh: six horns, bat wings, a split lion's tail, a dragon's maw, thirty feet tall
pictures.ct_born_king_2: A fey queen's face forming in the bark of a crooked tree, laughing
pictures.ct_fleeting_victory: A beast's head flickering into a thin man's face, mild and astonished
pictures.ct_fleeting_victory_2: A burst of gore, and then only a goat skull on the grass
pictures.ct_fleeting_victory_3: A face in the bark of the tree, shrieking
pictures.ct_underneath_the_crooked_moon: A single ember drifting down on the wind to the roots of a tree
pictures.ct_underneath_the_crooked_moon_3: A huge grinning moon, its grin twisting into a scowl
pictures.ct_crooked_defeat: A huge horned beast rearing and bellowing at a grinning moon
pictures.ct_crooked_defeat_2: A trunk splitting, a beautiful, terrible, crooked queen rising toward the moon
pictures.ct_crooked_defeat_3: The land below withering and twisting
